players.name: Ollie Gordon II
players.note: Achane is out for the season. Gordon handled every Miami RB touch after the injury while Wright was inactive: 17-41-1 rushing plus 3-14 receiving on an 82.1% snap share. Immediate Richard-specific priority.

players.name: Braelon Allen
players.note: Breece Hall is week-to-week with a quad/thigh injury. Allen reached a season-high 49.2% snap share, led the backfield with 19 routes and caught all three targets. Clear lead-back candidate if Hall sits.

players.name: Keaton Mitchell
players.note: Real Week 3 role growth: 35.9% snaps, 8 carries for 52 yards, 14 routes, 3 catches and five red-zone snaps. Hampton fell to 42% snaps. Mitchell adds standalone and contingency upside.

players.name: Mack Hollins
players.note: A.J. Brown is out into mid-October. Hollins caught 6 of 9 targets for 87 yards in Week 3 and owns a team-high 19.5% target share with 2.3 YPRR.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.note: Do not downgrade a quieter Week 3. Boston remained Cleveland's primary X at a 91.1% snap rate and has 9-195-2 through three games.
sources: Dawgs By Nature Week 3 snap counts

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
players.note: Week 3 production was modest, but Wicks remains Philadelphia's WR2 with about 2.8 YPRR. Earlier usage included a 23.1% first-read share. Role-and-efficiency add, not a box-score chase.

players.name: Kenyon Sadiq
players.note: Week 3 role jump: 57.6% snaps, 58.1% routes, 22.2% target share and 7-105-1 on eight targets. Breakout is credible, though TE is a lower Richard need with Kincaid.

players.name: Malik Washington
players.note: Led Miami with 34 routes and 10 targets in Week 3, catching five for 56 yards. Usage was about 84% routes, 27% target share and 29% air-yard share, plus two carries.

players.name: Kendre Miller
players.note: Etienne is expected to miss time. Miller played 19% of Week 3 snaps; after Etienne exited, Kamara played 20 snaps to Miller's 14. Cheap Richard-specific contingency, not a premium claim.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.note: Hold on IR. Charbonnet is approaching return eligibility and Seattle's Week 3 backfield split 36/36/28 among Holani, Wilson and Price with no one separating.

players.name: Kaelon Black
players.note: Hold rather than churn. Standalone work cooled to four carries for 17 yards in Week 3 behind a healthy McCaffrey, but Black remains a high-upside contingency back.

players.name: Jadarian Price
players.note: Downgrade. Healthy in Week 3 but played only 28% of snaps and was benched for several possessions; Wilson and Holani each played 36%. Role security is now the concern.

players.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
players.note: Major downgrade: just 23 of 62 snaps (37%) and one target for eight yards in Week 3; Meyers and Parker Washington each played 81%. Talent no longer justifies a premium claim until the role rebounds.

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.note: Reverse last week's add. Denver placed Coleman on short-term IR with a high ankle sprain; he must miss at least four games and Dobbins/Harvey are healthy.

players.name: De'Von Achane
players.note: Season-ending torn ACL in Week 3. In redraft, drop rather than occupy an IR slot.

players.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
players.note: Expected to miss time after aggravating the same-leg hamstring issue. Week 4 is out and an IR stint remains possible. Plan for multiple weeks without him.

players.name: Noah Fant
players.note: Two-TD trap. Fant went 4-33-2 but remains the Saints' TE2 and runs routes on about 44% of pass plays versus roughly 69% for Juwan Johnson.
